description: This file contains functions and setup procedures for configuring, renewing, and tearing down DHCPv6 protocol in a network environment, including parameter definitions and command execution.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 configuration parameters with default values and options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a prefix to a specified list or string.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the command if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 configuration, exports environment variables, and runs the DHCPv6 client command.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Sends a signal to renew the DHCPv6 lease.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Kills the DHCPv6 process for the interface.
